rows.outcome: *** ANSWERED, AND IT IS A YES. *** IU.631.434.2026, dated 22 September 2026, signed by the Director KAROLINA KAWCZYŃSKA, case officer dr MAŁGORZATA URBANOWSKA-CHYŁA. The reply says the digital copies of the BIRTH, MARRIAGE AND DEATH registers of URZĄD STANU CYWILNEGO SZUBIN MIASTO “have already been made available some time ago” on www.genealogiawarchiwach.pl, and supplies a direct link to THE BIRTH REGISTER FOR 1884 — the year Jacob Leibholz was born at Schubin on 8 August. It explains how to expand the table of contents on the black bar to the left, and says the scan of any record found may be downloaded straight from the portal. NO FEE, NO QUERY SERVICE, NO ACKNOWLEDGEMENT REQUESTED — unlike the Koszalin reply, this one asks for nothing back. THE CONTRAST WITH KOSZALIN IS THE WHOLE POINT: the Hammerstein registers are gone and the Szubin ones were online the entire time this archive was writing letters about them. || *** SECOND ANSWER, 25 SEPTEMBER 2026, AND IT ANSWERS ALL THREE QUESTIONS. *** IU.631.434.2026, Director KAROLINA KAWCZYŃSKA, officer dr MAŁGORZATA URBANOWSKA-CHYŁA. (1) THE JEWISH REGISTERS OF SZUBIN SURVIVE, 1820-1847 ONLY — wrong span for Friederica b. c.1852, RIGHT SPAN FOR ABRAHAM SCHMUL b. 1846. (2) DEATH INDEXES SURVIVE 1874-1878 AND 1894-1924 AND NOTHING ELSE ('wyłącznie'), so 1879-1893 is a stated gap; they attached sygn. 246, the 1894-1908 volume, WHICH THIS ARCHIVE HAD PUBLISHED AS NON-EXISTENT. (3) AND THE SMALL FAVOUR PAID BEST: an archivist read the 'Tochter der...' line — 'GASTWIRTH JUDA I JUTTA Z DOMU MACHOL SCHMUL JEGO ŻONA'. FRIEDERICA'S FATHER KEPT AN INN, and the mother is read JUTTA née MACHOL against the index's JETTE MACHOT.
rows.acknowledged: Not required — the letter asks for no confirmation of receipt.
rows.followup: SECOND LETTER SENT 22 September 2026 on the IU.631.434.2026 thread, message 1a0c8d2a92207d0f: asks directly whether Bydgoszcz holds the akta gminy wyznaniowej żydowskiej w Szubinie, since Friederica Schmul was born about 1852 and Prussian civil registration began only on 1 October 1874. rows.what: Czarne (Hammerstein) civil registers 1847 and 1884, and the synagogue books — the Leibholz family
rows.outcome: ANSWERED IN FIVE LINES AND IT IS A NEGATIVE. O-S.6342.406.2026, signed by Krzysztof Skrzypiec, Head of the Slupsk Branch. The Koszalin holdings contain NO registers of the former German civil registry office at Czarne (Standesamt Hammerstein, Kreis Schlochau) FOR 1874 TO 1899, and NO synagogue-community books for Czarne AT ALL — and no information about what became of either, or where they might now be held. *** ACKNOWLEDGED 17 SEPTEMBER, message 1a0ac71a500bc77f, in their own thread 1a0a98796538c64b, to slupsk@ as they asked and copied to the case officer. The acknowledgement tells them WHY a negative was useful — that it closes the only route to Georg Leibholz’s parents — thanks them specifically for saying they do not know where the books went, and closes the correspondence so they need not spend more time on it.

The parish marriage register of 7 September 1940
rows.outcome: *** ANSWERED IN FULL, IN A WEEK, AND THE ANSWER ON PARENTS IS NO. *** Arlene at the parish office replied to all five numbered questions. The 1940 parish marriage register SURVIVES and CONTAINS the entry; it DOES NOT NAME THE PARENTS — “Unfortunately not, as attached”. There is no second book: “the Catholic Church keeps one Marriage Register, the banns are included in the attached”, so the Original Marriage Register no. 13 of 1940 IS the parish register. Fr W. P. Whelan confirmed as parish priest at Rosebank from 1935, so the parish is the right one; the registers are held there, not at the Archdiocese. THIS CLOSES ROUTE 2 OF THE TWO ROUTES TO LEONARD'S PARENTAGE. A pure thank-you was sent the same day, message 1a0c8d21508292fb — no further request, because she answered everything asked.
